summary: Ronald Webber, 58, of Maitland, Florida was reported overdue Jan 21 from a winter mountaineering trek in the Longs Peak area (left the trailhead Jan 19); after ground and aerial searches of the Roaring Fork drainage and east cirque, his body was found Jan 22 at the base of a broken cliff band at Peacock Pool, ~1/2 mi east of Chasm Lake, after an apparent ~200-ft fall; flown to Upper Beaver Meadows and transferred to the Boulder County Coroner.
location: Peacock Pool, ~1/2 mi east of Chasm Lake, Longs Peak
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain National Park Search and Rescue
notes: DATE APPROXIMATE: reported-overdue/search-start date per the id-2421 convention; departed trailhead Jan 19, body located Jan 22; cause of death pending coroner. Parent-opened run 585.
